teaser: What happens when the one who wants to lead is also the one who cannot sit still long enough to finish the thing being led? You are a life path 1, called The Leader, crossed with ENFP, called The Inspirer. The 1 wants a single banner planted and held. The ENFP spots ten hills worth climbing before lunch. Put both in one person and the result starts ventures with real ease and sometimes hands them to someone else before the paint has dried. Not every number does this to this type. This one does.
